question: HCLTech Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET), online assessment with a Java section: a set of Java MCQs plus **two coding problems, one based on inheritance and one based on the switch statement.** The reported items give no exact statements, so the answer covers what such problems usually test.
lookingFor: Inheritance fundamentals: extends, super, overriding, constructor order.
Runtime polymorphism and which method or field is selected.
Correct use of switch: fall-through, break, default, allowed types.
Ability to write short, compilable Java under time pressure.
Careful reading of output-prediction and MCQ traps.
followUps: What is the difference between method overloading and overriding?
What happens if a parent class has no default constructor and the child does not call super explicitly?
Can a constructor be inherited or overridden?
Which data types are permitted in a switch statement, and what changed in newer Java versions?
